user.title: Connect PortalAI voice
user.description: Select your paired PortalAI and the physical voice devices allowed to use it. Keep PortalAI unlocked, idle, and on the dedicated voice chat you want to connect. Your signed-in HA administrator can also test this agent through Assist. Other HA users are refused.

confirm.title: Approve voice access to PortalAI
confirm.description: Connect account {account}, chat {chat}. Anyone speaking to the selected voice devices can use the tools granted to this PortalAI account. Responses and history are shared in this dedicated chat. Keep this chat selected: switching chats, locking PortalAI, an open dialog, or an active task prevents new voice commands. This adapter does not switch chats or bypass approval/Stop controls. A timeout can leave an action uncertain; check the chat before repeating it. No new token or network listener is created.

data.approve: Allow these voice devices to use this PortalAI chat and its granted tools

error.projection_unavailable: Unlock PortalAI, start projection, select an idle voice chat, and try again.
error.approval_required: Explicit approval is required to enable voice access.

abort.owner_required: An active Home Assistant administrator must configure this integration.
abort.projection_required: Set up and pair PortalAI Projection and PortalAI Native first.
abort.already_configured: This PortalAI projection already has a voice connection.
